observations.gait: Three pairs use phase offsets0,1.57,3.14 on joint yaw,upper/lower/foot roll; opposite side biases reverse sign. Uniform generic two-leg gait not used. It is procedural phase motion, not per-foot terrain collision/contact constraints.
observations.hurt: 10tick HURT registered. Model has no HURT branch, so this is a state/AI interval with ordinary final look/gait, not an invented keyframed recoil. AnimationTakeDamage reserves MOVE+JUMP, not LOOK. Parent nonlethal hurt requires NO_ANIMATION or hurtInterruptsAnimation plus playsHurtAnimation. Once idle goal start sets defaultfalse, ordinary hurt is not assumed to interrupt its clip; exact scheduler transition windows remain outside source closure.
observations.fatal_interrupt: Successful fatal parent hurt sends DIE even during idle/burrow; replacing nonempty animation resets tick0 without calling old onAnimationFinish. Old animation goal stop only sends NO_ANIMATION if its animation still matches, so a replacement death is not cleared by the old goal condition. No old pose snapshot/crossfade in selected engine path. Other native damage/invulnerability conditions not bypassed by this conclusion.
observations.death: Entity duration73; parent duration-20 yields server removal threshold53. Model keys7/2/2/18/12/12 sum53, not73. Initial body relativeX-3.5rad and head+1rad, controllerX/Y advance. ControllerX produces nonmonotonic body hop -18*(-4x²+4x); Y weights oscillatory struggle.29–41 legs/claws fold and Y decays0;41–53 finalhold. Do not assume full73tick visible.
observations.death_bias: calculateRotation returns invert?-(cos(...)*degree*f1+weight*f1):(...). With die controllerY0, oscillatory degree0 does not remove constant weight biases (left upper+0.9,right upper-0.9 for f1=1). Thus final leg pose includes keyframe ±0.7 plus procedural fixed bias, not keyframe target alone. No numerical whole-model replay claimed.
observations.burrow_entry: Two source entries: active flee ticks>=55 plus NO_ANIMATION/notNoAI/notFrozen and diggable beneath; or fifth onPathNotFound callback since reset from avoid goal (first4 increment, next triggers ifNO_ANIMATION). Base canUse tries10 random paths, invokes failure once after attempts; failure count is not ticks or10 independent cases. Failure-trigger override has no explicit diggable predicate. Native scheduler/randompath outcomes not run.
observations.burrow_body: Five4tick keyframes alternate bodyyaw ±0.4 and claw strokes while bodyY moves1,3,7,13,21.6. Model then writes static40, total60. Entity BURROW duration20 and finish handler discards; do not present late40 as normal visible native sequence. Particle/sound tests tick%4==3 do not certify blade/ground contacts.
observations.burrow_finish: onAnimationFinish checks old animation==BURROW then discard. Parent setter calls it when new animation==NO_ANIMATION, including an early clear, not exclusively a natural successful finish. Client auto-end at>=20 also invokes same hook locally; server goalstop sends NO when matching. No absolute same-frame client/server discard asserted. Direct BURROW→DIE does not call this hook before death by selected setter.
observations.mount_interface: No named socket part, no body mount/worldPos exporter and no held/accessory render layer in selected Grottol renderer. Crystals are parented body features, not interfaces. Existing FindMinecart MOVE+LOOK goal when fleeTime>1 chooses nearest valid empty alive rail Minecart, approaches then startRiding at<=1.45 distance. Grottol overrides start/stopRiding only to call super; isEffectiveAi false while in cart. Passenger placement remains native engine interface, not a custom claw socket.
observations.mount_exit: Server tick uses vehicle rail/ground and stopped conditions to eject passengers or drive along rail; visual parent/passenger transforms and cart engine not reconstructed. BlackPinkRailLine effect reader is a referenced but unread unrelated rail-content implementation; no claim it is animation/attachment verified.
observations.reload_and_restore: Idle resets relative pose before NO state. Hurt uses default model branch. Death and successful burrow terminate rather than stand up. Selected subclass NBT writes deepslate/blackpink; animation spawn index/tick comes from parent separately. Full standard-entity save/passenger load, fleeing counters and current clip reload not certified.
observations.transfer: Useful methods: explicit non-rendered controller, gait/head layer ordering, lifecycle end callbacks distinguished from restoration, physical limb chains vs generic humanoid joints. Six-legged upside-down death is not a Suanni quadruped head-ground template; no copied constants or character assets.
